text:
Radioactive waste is often mixed with liquid glass. This mixture solidifies and is stored in steel
drums.
Why is this process used to store radioactive waste?
A
It reduces the decay rate.
B
It reduces the half-life of the waste.
C
The waste is contained in a solid block so it cannot leak out.
D
The glass is transparent so the waste can be seen.

options.label: B
options.text: It reduces the half-life of the waste.

options.label: C
options.text: The waste is contained in a solid block so it cannot leak out.

options.label: D
options.text: The glass is transparent so the waste can be seen.
